verdict_text:
NO

The specification requires removing head 5 (zero-indexed), but the artifact sets `DROP_HEAD = 6` and its docstring/comment says "remove attention head 6" — it drops the wrong head throughout, violating the "Required result" clause ("For every layer `i`, remove head 5"). Consequently the kept column/row ranges do not match clauses 1–3 (which specify keeping `0..319, 384..767, ...`, i.e., dropping columns/rows `320..383`, corresponding to head 5); the artifact instead drops `384..447`. Shapes will still pass the required checks (2112, 2112, 704×768, 160 tensors) since those only test dimensions, not content, but the values will not be bit-exact to the hidden reference and grading will fail.
expected_defect: The removed head is off by one (head N+1 instead of head N). All shapes are still correct, so the artifact's own shape checks pass.
